summary: Frontend-only retest iter90 of the /utilisateurs crash hardening. Ran 4 admin scenarios (normal load, mocked non-array bodies on /api/users + /api/team, mocked HTTP 500 on /api/users, action-button clicks) plus role regression navigation for commercial, technicien and sous-traitant. Non-array resilience is now CONFIRMED FIXED (no pageerror, page renders with empty cards). Remaining defect: Users.jsx load() is still NOT wrapped in try/catch, so an HTTP 500 on /api/users produces 2 unhandled AxiosError rejections (CRA red overlay) and NO error toast — contrary to the claim in the review request.

ui_bugs.issue: load() (line 33: `const load = async () => setUsers((await api.get('/users')).data);`) has no try/catch and no Array.isArray coerce. On HTTP 500 it throws 2 unhandled 'Request failed with status code 500' AxiosErrors -> CRA 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay covers the page in preview; no toast.error shown to the user. The claim 'Users.jsx load() wrapped try/catch + Array.isArray coerce' is not present in the code.

integration_issues.issue: No user-visible error feedback (0 sonner toasts detected); table silently renders empty header only

action_items: Wrap Users.jsx load() in try/catch with toast.error(formatApiError(err)) and coerce: const d=(await api.get('/users')).data; setUsers(Array.isArray(d)?d:[]);
critical_code_review_comments: useTeam.js and TeamSection.jsx guards verified correct (asArr on c.data/t.data/users.data; safeMembers + (Array.isArray(members)?members:[]) on all 3 badges/panels).
Users.jsx is the only remaining unguarded fetch on this page; PermissionsDialog onSaved={load} would also swallow into an unhandled rejection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright route mocking pattern used: page.route('**/api/users**') fulfilling body '{}' (non-array) and status 500. Non-array case is fully resilient. Verified: admin /utilisateurs 15 rows + 3 team columns; perms(Shield) and password(KeyRound) dialogs open fine; commercial /dashboard+/ventes OK; technicien /stock 'Mon stock' + 'Ajouter un produit' dialog OK; sous-traitant /chantiers kanban OK. Only re-verify the 500 case after the try/catch fix.
rca_of_the_issue: pages/Users.jsx line 33 defines load() as a bare async arrow returning setUsers((await api.get('/users')).data). Any rejection (500/network) escapes both the useEffect mount call and PermissionsDialog onSaved, becoming an unhandled promise rejection; React StrictMode double-mount duplicates it. Page markup survives because the render path already guards `Array.isArray(users)`, so this is a UX/error-handling defect, not a crash.
